skills.name: Unraveled Spring
skills.description:
Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance

Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Cloud Breath on hit.

Mid-air Attack - Zephyr Stance

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Cloud Breath on hit.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance Stage 4.

skills.name: Vernal Screen
skills.description:
Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance

While in Zephyr Stance and Cloud Breath is not full, press Resonance Skill to have Suisui thrust forward, dealing Glacio DMG. If Suisui is the active Resonator while casting the skill, restore Cloud Breath.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.

Awakening Spring

While in Zephyr Stance and at full Cloud Breath, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Awakening Spring. Casting this skill consumes all Cloud Breath, pulls in nearby targets, and sends Suisui into Drizzle Stance, dealing Glacio DMG and inflicting Glacio Chafe on the target 1 time on hit.

Enrichment

Casting Awakening Spring or Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade grants all nearby Resonators in the team 1 stack of Enrichment. This effect can be triggered once every 25s. Incoming Resonators receive healing from Suisui at the cost of Enrichment.

Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance

While in Drizzle Stance, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.
Press Resonance Skill to have Suisui thrust forward, dealing Glacio DMG. If Suisui is the active Resonator while casting the skill, restore Floral Epistle.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance.

skills.name: Song of Thoroughfare
skills.description:
Casting the skill deploys Ceaseless Landscape that lasts for 30s. When Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui enters the Roaming Transcendent state when casting Outro Skill - Rippling Waters.
Ceaseless Landscape grants all nearby Resonators in the team the following enhancements:
- Inflicting a target with Spectro Frazzle, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, and Aero Erosion, or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limit of the corresponding Negative Status the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Inflicting a target with Electro Flare or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limits of Electro Flare and Electro Rage the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Consuming Havoc Bane stacks on the target after landing a skill allows the Resonator's Havoc DMG to ignore the target's DEF by 6% and Havoc RES by 12% for 30s. This effect does not stack.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

skills.name: Sky Over Water
skills.description:
Consuming Enrichment grants the Resonator 10 stacks of Spring's Birth, up to 10 stacks. When the Resonator with Spring's Birth is not at full HP, restore their HP by 62 + 0.34% of Suisui's Max HP at the cost of 1 stack of Spring's Birth every 2s.

When Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring and Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade hit a target, they additionally restore 18 points of Concerto Energy and 13 points of Resonance Energy, and increase the attack's Crit. Rate by 80% and Glacio DMG by 240%. This effect can be triggered up to once every 25s.

skills.name: Glimmering Gold
skills.description: When a Resonator other than Suisui takes a fatal blow, they will not be knocked out but will instead regain 50% of Suisui's current HP, while Suisui herself loses the same amount of HP. Suisui's HP will not go below 1 from this effect. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minutes.

skills.name: Tinkling Jade
skills.description:
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, and inflict Glacio Chafe 1 time on the target.
While casting this skill, consume all Cloud Breath to pull in nearby targets and enter Drizzle Stance.

skills.name: Lambent Gold
skills.description:
Zephyr Stance

Suisui is in Zephyr Stance by default. When in Zephyr Stance, Suisui can obtain Cloud Breath through certain skills.

Drizzle Stance

Entering Drizzle Stance clears all Floral Epistle.
During Drizzle Stance:
- Suisui unlocks new combat moves and restores Floral Epistle through certain skills.
-Suisui gains increased resistance to interruption.
- Press Normal Attack within a certain time after triggering a successful Dodge via Dodge skills to cast Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 1.
After entering Drizzle Stance for 15s, Suisui ends Drizzle Stance and clears all Floral Epistle upon exiting the state.

Dodge - Parting Mist

While performing attacks on the ground, press Dodge to cast Dodge - Parting Mist at the cost of STA.
When in Zephyr Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Cloud Breath. Press Normal Attack shortly after triggering the Dodge to cast Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance.
- When in Drizzle Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Floral Epistle, and does not reset the cycle of Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance within a certain period.

Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance

When in Drizzle Stance, Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance.
Press Normal Attack repeatedly to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.
When casting Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 3,  continuously pull in nearby targets.
Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4 inflicts Glacio Chafe 1 time on the target on hit.

Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.

Illuminating Dew

When in Drizzle Stance, keep holding Normal Attack after casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance to cast this skill.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Swallow's Cut

When in Drizzle Stance, cast this skill in one of the following ways:
- Release the Normal Attack button while casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance.
- Press Normal Attack while Suisui is mid-air.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Cloud Breath

Max 120 points.
When in Zephyr Stance:
- Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance and Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance restore Cloud Breath on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance restores 40 points of Cloud Breath when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 35 points of Cloud Breath.

Floral Epistle

Max 600 points.
When in Drizzle Stance:
- Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance and Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance restore Floral Epistle on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance restores 100 points of Floral Epistle when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 102 points of Floral Epistle.

skills.name: Skillful Cooking
skills.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: Rippling Waters
skills.description:
Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

Suisui enters Roaming Transcendent when Ceaseless Landscape is active.
Suisui exits Drizzle Stance and consumes all Floral Epistle and unlocks the following effects based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed:

0 Floral Epistle consumed:
- All nearby Resonators in the team gain Reflecting Shadows for 6s. Resonators with Reflecting Shadows have increased resistance to interruption.

At least 200 Floral Epistle consumed:
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform Plume Step for the first time within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 400 Floral Epistle consumed:
- During this Roaming Transcendent state, the active Resonator within the Ceaseless Landscape deals more DMG if they have Reflecting Shadows. For every 1% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator deals 0.2% more DMG, up to 12%.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the second Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 600 Floral Epistle consumed:
- When Suisui performs the first Plume Step, all nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape gain the following effects for the duration of this Roaming Transcendent:
- When they cast Outro Skill, Suisui grants the incoming Resonator Undulating Mist. When Resonators with Undulating Mist consume Negative Status or Electro Rage stacks on the target, they gain an ATK increase: For every 0.12% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator's ATK is increased by 0.1% for 6s, up to 50%. Undulating Mist lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched off the field. When Undulating Mist is removed, the ATK increase effect is also removed.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the third Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

Roaming Transcendent

Lasts for 30s.
During Roaming Transcendent, Suisui will merge with Ceaseless Landscape and start a Transcendent Dance, during which she will perform Plume Steps at intervals based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed when Outro Skill - Rippling Waters is cast.
When Suisui is the active Resonator in the team, she stops the Transcendent Dance.
When Ceaseless Landscape isn't active, she will exit the Roaming Transcendent state.

Plume Step

Performing Plume Step grants Reflecting Shadows to all nearby Resonators in the team for 6s, inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on all enemies within the Ceaseless Landscape, and heals the nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape.

skills.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
skills.description: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

sequences.name: Mountains Washed Into Paintings
sequences.description:
Resonators with Undulating Mist also gain ATK increase after inflicting Negative Status or dealing Negative Status DMG.
The duration of Reflecting Shadows obtained through the third Plume Step is extended by 100%.
Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance, Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance, Plunging Attack - Illuminating Dew and Plunging Attack - Swallow's Cut are immune to interruption.

sequences.name: Clouds Pour Like Molten Gold
sequences.description:
All nearby Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape have their Crit. DMG increased by 50% for 30s after performing the following actions:
- Inflicting Spectro Frazzle, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, Aero Erosion, and Electro Flare, or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG.
- Consuming Havoc Bane stacks on the target.
When the active Resonator is not in the Ceaseless Landscape, this Crit. DMG bonus effect is disabled.

sequences.name: Sparse Curtains Invite Evening Glow
sequences.description:
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance to cast Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4.

Casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance grants Kingfisher. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect. Casting Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4 consumes Kingfisher to restore 20 points of Concerto Energy and 350 points of Floral Epistle. Kingfisher can be consumed up to once every 25s.

sequences.name: Autumn Mountains in Choir Sing
sequences.description: Healing provided by Enrichment and  Spring's Birth are increased by 50%.

sequences.name: I Long To Ride The Eastern Wind
sequences.description: The DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance and Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance are increased by 100%.

sequences.name: Staying True To This Splendid Realm
sequences.description: The Crit. DMG of Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade and Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring is increased by 500%.
